# ============================================================
# How to use this file on a NEW computer:
#   1. Install Python, then create a virtual environment: python -m venv venv
#   2. Activate it, then run: pip install -r requirements.txt
#   3. That installs every library this project needs, with the exact same
#      versions as the machine this file was generated on — so you get an
#      identical setup, not "whatever the latest version happens to be".
# venv/ itself is never uploaded to GitHub (it's in .gitignore) — this file
# is what recreates it on a new machine.
# ============================================================
